text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's a summer camp tradition! Ghost story time!
First one to get scared loses!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, hold up!
Just you being there is terrifying enough!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I can't take this anymore!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the MC suddenly taking off, only a few
quiet Umamusume were left behind on the night beach.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san... Um...
It's not exactly a ghost story, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Could you tell me more?
About Leckermund the Witch."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "...Understood. That said, exaggerated information wouldn't be very helpful as a reference, so—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I will share this as closely to the original text as possible.
Regarding the Brothers Grimm fairy tale, "Hänsel und Gretel".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Hansel and Gretel."
The famous story about the gingerbread house, but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Hansel and Gretel were abandoned in the forest to reduce the number of mouths to feed during a long famine.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Living in that forest was the witch Leckermaul.
Leckermaul saved the two and invited them inside, but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It was all to fatten them up and eventually turn them into nutrients for itself.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Nibble-Maw ordered
little sister Gretel:
"Cook up food to fatten your brother Hansel."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A sister who makes, a brother who eats, a witch who directs.
Toward the predetermined conclusion,
the three gears turn with precision.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It is all to end up in Leckermaul's stomach one day.
In other words, Hansel's life—is for death.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That witch is... Leckermäulchen...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: So that I can eat it someday...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sister who feeds Hansel to fatten him up.
Or perhaps that role belongs to...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't shake the feeling that I was the one bearing it.
I couldn't just laugh it off as a simple fairy tale.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san... Sometimes, I...
I see... "witches."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
No, "something like a witch."
Though I do not know if that is truly what it is...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I see. You could call it a hallucination,
but I'm not particularly fond of that interpretation.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hallucinations, too, are things seen with one's eyes.
If you truly feel that you can see it...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"There might be something within you that causes
such hallucinations. For instance—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Something like... "witch's blood."
A lineage stemming from the forests of Germany,
even if only a few milliliters flow through my veins...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The blood... of a witch...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: That's having an effect...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And if this is the guidance of witch's blood...
then eventually, I will be... a sacrifice...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was an unsettling tale. Even if it were just a fairy tale,
it could affect Manhattan Cafe's morale.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Chasing after the "friend" might be impossible after all...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! Do you have a moment...?
Excuse me, but about witches...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Um...
N-not all witches are bad...!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The witch in the "Gingerbread House" is evil,
but there are plenty of good witches out there too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: You are... Zenno Rob Roy-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Zenno Rob Roy. A bookworm Umamusume
who is well-versed in all kinds of stories.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She offered a gentle smile
and began to speak quietly.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A famous example of a good witch would be...
the Good Witch of the North from "The Wizard of Oz," for instance.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Even in the German fairy tale "Little Briar Rose,"
one of the wise women extends the princess's life.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"It's true that witches often lure someone
away somewhere. But..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Where she invites you
all depends on the witch, I believe.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Well... that is true. One should judge someone by their true essence, not by their label.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended up turning into something entirely different from a ghost story, but it was interesting in its own right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe stared at Zenno Rob Roy as if utterly drawn to her, and then...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Um... Zenno Rob Roy-san...
You...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Could you tell me your plans for the autumn?
Your race schedule. Could it be...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
My race schedule for the fall...? Well,
the ones I'm thinking of registering for are...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup, right?
I was hoping to aim to become a hero there.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "Incredible Umamusume, true witch-level prodigies from all over the world, will gather there. I'd love to compete against them."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I knew it...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's this person.
I sense 'friends' all around them...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
This person is... my next rival...
Someone who will give me something. And, beyond that...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seemed there was indeed some interference, to a greater or lesser degree, regarding the decision to run in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't know whether 'salvation' or 'ruin' awaits ahead.
Even so, the next checkpoint is in sight.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "Are you also running in the Japan Cup? If so, I look forward to competing with you."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Let us enjoy it. The autumn festival.
—Walpurgis Night.
